title: Rendez-vous
subtitle: One room, one agent, one artifact — many humans, on the surfaces they already use.

title: Work is multiplayer. Agents are single-player.
bullets: Every agent lives in exactly one person's window.

title: So the human becomes the integration layer.
bullets: Copy-paste relay between two separate chat windows.
Screenshots of chats, forwarded to the other side.
“Let me ask the AI and get back to you.”
The second person never sees the context.
The deliverable dies inside one private thread.

title: One agent. Many humans. No new app.
bullets: One agent session, many humans, on their own surfaces.
No install. No shared login. No new app.
highlight: Sandboxes are now commodity — nine partners, one API call, each single-principal.

title: Two people, two surfaces, one artifact, attributed.

timelineItems.label: A real phone types “new” on Telegram — the room exists
Cold boot — session and artifact ready
A second person joins from the laptop
The agent finds the artifact and edits it, unaided

caption: Delivery confirmed on the phone.

title: Every message becomes one artifact.
bullets: Messenger — WhatsApp, Telegram: quick text in, terse replies out.
Email — reply-to-thread turns, a per-turn digest back.
Room-web — laptop, full transcript, the live artifact.
code:
agentpush ingress
  → room  (many contacts, one session)
  → fan-out  (by presence tier)
  → e2b sandbox
  → artifact URL
highlight: Built on our own open-source runtime — unmodified, from npm.

title: Credentials are per-member, not per-room.
bullets: A shared room key is shared with anyone holding the code.
Each member attaches their own tools over rendezvous — nothing inherited.
Revocation is an unpair, not a key rotation.

title: Work leaves the room — on purpose.

findingsItems.label: Jeremy asks the room to build a presentation, then reviews it live at the artifact URL
the room previews it first — recipient, channel, subject, the rendered artifact — and sends only when a member explicitly confirms
the PDF reaches Jeremy's own messenger, and by email, a client who is not a member of the room
every send lands in the shared transcript: who asked, who confirmed, what was sent, to whom

highlight: Every other capability keeps work inside the room. This one lets it leave — with authority, not just relay.
caption: Code done, tested — the first live send still bypassed the room's own flow.

title: One shape, five independent bugs.

findingsItems.label: a killed session still answers 200 — resume reported success doing nothing
queue: true omitted — a mid-turn prompt is silently dropped
the resume cursor freezes — every reply after it vanishes
an account-pinned route never fires — filtered out silently
the agent proposes rebuilding a Gmail capability it already had

highlight: Four of these five lost data quietly. This one reported success while doing nothing.
caption: None crash. All look like working code or correct config.

title: Four things we haven't proven yet.
bullets: Resume-after-kill: fixed, but not yet re-proved on a phone.
Paused sandboxes expire in 20 to 60 minutes.
WhatsApp: not provisioned — no number, no key.
Shared inbound routing risks a responder double reply.

title: It failed at the auth gate, not the swap.
bullets: Tested live: the swap alone hit a login wall first.
installAdapters installs the binary — not a login.
code:
agent_start({ adapter: "codex", model: "gpt-5.2-codex", ... })

→ 500 sandbox_proxy_failed
   "no codex login found — run `codex login`"

box destroyed on failure — boots used: 1 of 1
highlight: The credential model — device-auth — is the real second-brain work, not the adapter swap.
caption: docs/CODEX-FLIP.md — variant A only; B and C untested (1-boot budget).

title: Why a room, not two people and one bot.

findingsItems.label: the agent asks Alice for the product shot
the agent asks Bob for the one-line positioning
each answers on their own channel, in their own time
the agent synthesizes both into the deck — sent as a PDF

highlight: The agent addresses each member individually and reconciles what they contribute.
caption: Specced, not yet built.
